teach.goal: Abrir a aula: objetivo e primeira hipótese.

facts.label: Passado: problema em casa
facts.sub: Use leaked, heard, closed e used para explicar o problema. Pergunte When did it start? Did you turn off the water? e responda It started last night.

facts.label: O vazamento
facts.sub: Para explicar um vazamento, diga My sink leaked this morning e It started last night. Dê o lugar e a hora: assim o encanador entende o tamanho do problema antes de chegar.

facts.label: O que fez
facts.sub: Conte o que já tentou: I closed the valve, I used towels, I cleaned the floor. Isso mostra que você agiu e ajuda o profissional a escolher as ferramentas certas.

compare.br: No Brasil, o encanador costuma dar um horário aproximado e às vezes atrasa.

pages.title: A small kitchen · 1/3
paragraphs: It is eight in the morning in a small kitchen in Austin. Water drips under the sink. Lia holds her phone in one hand and a towel in the other. She dials the number on the plumber’s card. A calm voice answers. She explains the problem.
“Hello, this is Al. How can I help?” says Al. “Hi, Al. My kitchen sink leaked this morning.” says Lia. “When did it start?” says Al.
